scope: pre-final-scoring 4LY-003 split geometry amendment, no plant or acceptance thresholds changed
reason: The initial split translation had converted pure vertical and horizontal training tasks into diagonal ones and displaced the unsupported hover target away from its own starting position. The correction preserves each nominal task family across the three meaningful geometry splits.

semantics.unsupported_hover: Goal equals actual new start in every split; no navigation credit
semantics.horizontal_reach: Goal y equals start y; travel distance at least 60 cells in every split
semantics.arrival_braking: Goal y equals start y; requires true horizontal low-speed dwell
semantics.reverse: Both goals share actual start y, reverse X after first waypoint dwell
semantics.vertical_reach: Goal x equals start x; tune target y=158 and final y=147 preserve upward displacement >=60 cells
semantics.negative_controls: Remote target remains >60 cells from start in every split
semantics.obstacles: Distinct per-split authored start, goal and extra native obstacles; contact clearance remains separately measured
